video_title: Chandler - Thunder BACK to Being the BEST Team in NBA!

quotes.speaker: Chandler Parsons
quotes.summary_phrase: Thunder's roster remains deep and efficient with same core group
quotes.excerpt: They played 11 guys again last night and they look like the same team.
quotes.quote: I looked at the moves that they made in the offseason, the pieces that they got rid of and I was like, maybe we're going to look at a more refined, efficient group where they're going to still play eight guys and it's just going to be more of McCain, it's going to be more of Wallace, it's going to be more of some of these guys that were playing roles last year. And nope, they played 11 guys again last night and they look like the same team. They were able to bug and play.

quotes.speaker: Chandler Parsons
quotes.summary_phrase: Thunder's hunger to prove themselves after last season's playoff loss
quotes.excerpt: They look like the team that lost in Game 7 last year to go to the NBA Finals.
quotes.quote: They look like the big brother again. All that talk about hunger, like they look like they wanted it more, they look like they had something to prove. They look like the team that lost in Game 7 last year to go to the NBA Finals and wanted to get it back. It starts with SGA. He was unbelievable and it's nothing new. He still just gets to his spot, he still creates, stops on a dime. Like he's going to do what he does regardless. Jalen Williams to me was key. He looked healthy. He didn't have the best game of his career, but at least physically he looked like himself getting to the rim, he was finishing. He looked like the J-Dub of the past.

quotes.speaker: Chandler Parsons
quotes.summary_phrase: Chet Holmgren's increased physicality and effort on the court
quotes.excerpt: Chet to me finally took it personal. I was watching him in particular, every box out.
quotes.quote: Chet to me finally took it personal. I was watching him in particular, every box out he was finding Wemby. Every attempt to try and go meet him at the rim, he tried to meet him at the rim. Every time he could be physical, after a timeout, he would go to the elbow where Wemby was trying to get to and he would get down in his stance and put his shoulder into Wemby's chest. I've never seen Chet do that kind of stuff and he needed that to happen last night because they do have heart and sign.

quotes.speaker: Chandler Parsons
quotes.summary_phrase: Cason Wallace's development and role as a point guard
quotes.excerpt: Cason Wallace gets the bag. He kind of just replaces Lou Dort and almost gives them more.
quotes.quote: And this young boy Mara, he is going to be so good at basketball. He can pick and pop, he can start the break, he can kind of fake a dribble handoff and get to the rim. This dude has game. He is going to be really important for them. And Cason Wallace, he gets the bag. He kind of just replaces Lou Dort and almost gives them a little bit more with offense and initiating, playing the point guard position. So he's unbelievable and this team just never ceases to amaze me.

quotes.speaker: DeMarcus Cousins
quotes.summary_phrase: Chet Holmgren's growth and offseason work on his game
quotes.excerpt: I agree with Chandler, it started with Chet's energy, embracing that matchup.
quotes.quote: I agree with Chandler, it started with Chet's energy, embracing that matchup. He's been getting a lot of heat since that playoff series and you can tell he spent a lot of time thinking about it and figuring out ways of becoming a better player in the offseason. So that was a great first showing for him, just embracing everything that we've been asking for, like embrace the challenge, meet Wemby head up and he did all of those things and it was a very impressive defensive showing.

quotes.speaker: DeMarcus Cousins
quotes.summary_phrase: SGA's status as an all-time great player
quotes.excerpt: I think it's time to start having some conversations around his name, man.
quotes.quote: I think it's time to start having some conversations around his name, man. Obviously he's one of the top players in the league but I'm talking just a legacy. We're talking possibly top five all-time as far as his position. So if he continues on this pace, those conversations are going to have to change and it's going to become some uncomfortable conversations. It is what it is, he's earned it. We're talking about somebody that may compete for his third MVP. That list is Bill Russell, Wilt Chamberlain, Larry Bird and if he does it again, so where are we putting him?

quotes.speaker: DeMarcus Cousins
quotes.summary_phrase: Mara's impressive debut and impact on the game
quotes.excerpt: I'm really impressed with the rookie Mara, coming in the game, his first play of the season.
quotes.quote: I'm really impressed with the rookie Mara, coming in the game, his first play of the regular season is a huge block on one of the best players in the league with Wemby. And obviously the numbers don't show anything amazing but it was just the quick impact. Came in, you got Wemby two quick fouls, so just coming in as a young player, looking prepared, looking ready like he's been here before, shout out to him. But I think he's going to be a really special player in this league.

quotes.speaker: Chandler Parsons
quotes.summary_phrase: Mara's impact on the game despite modest stats
quotes.excerpt: With a team like that, it's just about impact. His numbers didn't jump off the board.
quotes.quote: With a team like that, it's just about impact. His numbers didn't jump off the board, but if you watched that game, he was impactful. In a lot of ways where Wemby is able to just do what he wants to do, there was somebody there that was his size that was challenging him in plays that's usually kind of easy for him. So that's an impact. That's somebody that you go get in a draft for this reason, for him to be a player to be able to match up with the top guys in the league and he was able to do it last night.

quotes.speaker: DeMarcus Cousins
quotes.summary_phrase: Reflecting on the draft process and expectations for Mara
quotes.excerpt: During the draft process, I was hosting the show and Mara came up when they drafted him.
quotes.quote: During the draft process, I was hosting the show and Mara came up when they drafted him and they tried to put the title on him as, oh, OKC's drafted him to be the Wemby stopper. And I'm like, man, don't put that type of pressure on this kid. Like that's unfair to him. That's a tough task for anybody in this league. So you just reminded me of something and for this to be his first game and for him to come out and show what he did, it might not be far off.

quotes.speaker: Chandler Parsons
quotes.summary_phrase: Thunder's depth and the potential of their roster
quotes.excerpt: We haven't mentioned Alex Caruso. We haven't mentioned AJ Mitchell who was unbelievable last year.
quotes.quote: Think about how good of a fit that is that you have a thin Chet who doesn't really want to take the abuse of playing five all the time and Hartenstein. Now you add this guy, just falls to you in the draft. It is exactly what you need to kind of six fouls in the playoff even. We haven't mentioned Alex Caruso. We haven't mentioned AJ Mitchell who was unbelievable last year. The other Jalen Williams is probably a starter on half of the NBA teams and we don't even talk about him because he is a starter.
